resources.string: Each night, on Wi-Fi and while charging, the app plans tomorrow\'s usual trips (Home to places with a routine, and your saved trips), so they are there with no signal in the morning. Only options still ahead are shown. At most %d searches a night.
Set one of your saved places as Home (below) to include your routines.
Use \"⁨%s⁩\" as your Home? Night refresh plans from it.
